name: Mater Dei Catholic High School
description: At Mater Dei Catholic High School, students attend an academically rigorous school with unique programs that will stand out on university applications. The school offers students an elite, innovative Academy of Science Program, where students with a passion for STEM gain hands-on experience. Students can also take a social entrepreneurship course that was founded by a retired Technology Industry CEO, where students launch their own real small businesses. Students at Mater Dei Catholic High School also achieve incredible results - with consistent acceptances to Top 30 universities (including MIT, CalTech, Yale University, University of Chicago, and Cornell University), free after school SAT and ACT tutoring, and an incredible record of internships, with students in the summer of 2019 completing over 140 internships. The campus is also very advanced, with a recently-built campus, updated facilities, state-of-the-art technology and incredible outdoor space. Timestamps Updated
